payload_cleanup_command:
marker=/var/tmp/openaev-created-art.uid
if [ -f "$marker" ] && [ "$(stat -c %u "$marker")" = 0 ] && [ "$(id -u art 2>/dev/null)" = "$(cat "$marker")" ]; then
  userdel -rf art
fi
rm -f "$marker"
payload_description: Create a local account named art with the password art, switch to it to run whoami, then remove it: only an account this run created is removed, and an account named art that already exists is left as it is.
